description: File an unattached receipt against a transaction. A transaction holds at most ONE receipt, so this returns a conflict if another is already attached — detach that one first. Also clears any pending match suggestion, since the user has now decided.

receiptId.description: Receipt id to attach (from list_receipts output).

transactionId.description: Transaction id to attach it to. Resolve this from get_transactions first — this is the internal id, not the transaction hash.

name: attach_receipt
